newsitem.title: EU: Reuter European Court of Justice Diary for Tuesday, March 4-Thursday, March 13.
newsitem.headline: Reuter European Court of Justice Diary for Tuesday, March 4-Thursday, March 13.

text.p: (All venues Luxembourg, Plateau de Kirchberg)
TUESDAY, MARCH 4

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-189/95 Franzen: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 30 and 37. Swedish monopoly of certain alcoholic beverages. Distribution monopoly. Authorisation given to one exclusive dealer under state control. - Opinion C-398/95 Syndesmos ton en Elladi Touristikon: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 59 and 60. National regulation that considers the link between tour guides and travel agencies as coming necessarily under the right to work law. - Oral procedure C-296/95 EMU tabac: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 8 of Council directive 92/12/EEC of February 25, 1992, on the general policy on the detention, movement and inspection of products subject to excise tax. Tobacco products acquired to meet the particular needs of a member state A by its agent in member state B, the movement of which to member state A is assured by said agent. Exclusion from collection of excise tax by member state A.
WEDNESDAY, MARCH 5

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FOURTH CHAMBER (enlarged) (0915/0815 GMT) - Judgment T-105/95 World Wide Fund for Nature UK v/ Commission: institutional law. Annulment of Commission decision of February 2, 1995, refusing the claimant access to documents pertaining to the "Mullaghmore project" on the use of EU structural funds for the construction of a visitors centre at Burren National Park (Ireland).
THURSDAY, MARCH 6

COURT OF JUSTICE, FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-405/95 Bioforce: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. interpretation of Common Customs and Excise Tariff - NC 1994 - positions 3004 (drugs) and 2208.9069 (other spirits) - extract of echinacca purpurea e herba and e radice with alcohol added used to prevent colds and flu, etc.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-26/96 Rotexchemie: trade policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Validity of Council regulation 1531/88 of March 31, 1988, on a definitive anti-dumping duty on Chinese imports of potassium permanganate and instituting the definitive collection of the temporary antidumping duty on these imports.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-266/95 Merino Garcia: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Validity of annex I, 1.C.(a) of Council regulation 1408/71 of June 14, 1971, on social security schemes for employed persons and their families moving within the EU as amended and updated by Council regulation 2001/83 of June 2, 1983. Scope of application of said regulation as regards German family benefit. Worker on unpaid leave. - Opinion C-285/95 Kol: external relations. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 6, paragraph 1 and 14, paragraph 1 of EU/Turkey Association Council directive 1/80. Worker, right of stay. Regular employer. Residence permit obtained on the basis of willfully false declarations constituting an infraction. Expulsion. General measure of prevention. - Opinion C-354/95 Farmer's Union: agriculture. Interpretation of article 9 of Commission regulation 3887/92 of December 23, 1992, laying down detailed rules for applying the integrated administration and control system for certain EU aid schemes. Operators the area of whose tract as declared in requests for "area" aids exceed by more than 20 percent those effectively determined during inspection. Refusal of aid. - Opinion C-386/95 Eker: external relations. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 6, paragraph 1, first hyphen, of EU/Turkey Association Council directive 1/80. Right to renew a work permit with the same employer after one year of regular employment. Notion of regular employment. Employment with several successive employers. - Opinion C-154/96 Wolfs: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council directive 79/7/EEC of December 29, 1978, on the progressive implementation of the principle of equal treatment for men and women in social security matters. Old age benefit. National law laying down a flexible retirement age for men and women - different means of calculation for men and women. - Opinion C-311/96 Commission v/ France: company law. Non respect. Failure to have taken the proper legal, regulatory and administrative provisions to conform to Council directive 93/38/EEC of June 14, 1993, on coordination procedures for public procurement supply contracts in the water, energy, transport and telecommunications sectors. Reuter European Court of Justice Diary (page 2/2) - Opinion C-312/96 Commission v/ France: company law. Non respect. Failure to have taken the proper legal, regulatory and administrative provisions to conform to Council directive 93/36/EEC of June 14, 1993, on coordination procedures for public procurement supply contracts. - Oral procedure C-36/96 Guenaydin: external relations. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 6 of EU/Turkey Association Council directive 1/80. Worker belonging to the regular work force of a member state. Turkish citizen having had a temporary work permit with an employer with a view to preparing himself for an executive role in a Turkish affiliate of this employer. Request for permanent residence permit. Abuse of rights. - Oral procedure C-98/96 Ertanir: external relations. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 6 of EU/Turkey Association Council directive 1/80. Worker belonging to a member state's regular job market. Periods not covered by a residence or working permit. Effects of residence and working permits expressly limited as to their duration and use.
PROVISIONAL AGENDA FOR TUESDAY-THURSDAY, MARCH 11-13
TUESDAY, MARCH 11

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-13/95 Suezen: social policy. - Judgment C-264/95-P Commission v/ UIC: competition. - Judgment C-357/95-P ENU v/ Commission: contracts. - Oral procedure C-409/95 Marschall: social policy.
WEDNESDAY, MARCH 12

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure C-49/92-P Commission v/ Anic Partecipazioni: competition. - Oral procedure C-51/92-P Hercules Chemicals v/ Commission: competition. - Oral procedure C-199/92-P Huels v/ Commission: competition. - Oral procedure C-200/92-P ICI v/ Commission: competition. - Oral procedure C-227/92-P Hoechst v/ Commission: competition. - Oral procedure C-234/92-P Shell v/ Commission: competition. - Oral procedure C-235/92-P Montecatini v/ Commission: competition. - Oral procedure C-245/92-P Chemie Linz v/ Commission: competition. - Oral procedure C-5/93-P DSM v/ Commission: competition.
COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, SECOND CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure T-76/94 Ladbroke Racing v/ Commission: state aid.

FIFTH CHAMBER (enlarged) (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure T-150/95 British Iron and Steel Producers Association v/ Commission: state aid. - Oral procedure T-170/94 Shanghai Bicycle v/ Council: trade policy.
THURSDAY, MARCH 13
COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-368/95 Familapress Zeitungsverlag: free movement of goods.
FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-358/95 Morellato: free movement of goods. - Opinion C-130/96 Solisnor-Estaleiros Navais: taxation.
SECOND CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-109/95 Astir: agriculture.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-131/95 Huijbrechts: free movement of persons. - Judgment C-103/96 Eridania Beghin-Say: free movement of goods. - Judgment C-197/96 Commission v/ France: social policy. - Opinion C-322/95 Iurlaro: free movement of persons. - Opinion joined cases C-313/96, C-356/96, C-358/96 Commission v/ Belgium: approximation of legislation.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-104/96 Cooperatieve Rabobank "Vecht en Plassengebied": company law. - Opinion C-131/96 Mora Romero: free movement of persons. - Oral procedure C-165/95 Lay: agriculture. - Oral procedure (1045/0945 GMT) C-55/96 Job Centre: free movement of persons.
COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FIRST CHAMBER (enlarged) (1430/1330 GMT) - Oral procedure joined cases T-195/94, T-202/94 Quiller v/ Council and Commission: agriculture.
